name: scale_length
label: Scale length
description: Vibrating string length from the nut to the saddles: 24 in (610 mm) to 27 in (686 mm); 648 mm is 25.5 in

name: body_thickness
label: Body thickness
description: Thickness at the level plateau that carries the neck, the pickups and the bridge

name: pocket_tangent_y
expr: heel_end_y + heel_end_radius + heel_end_radius / (heel_end_radius - router_radius) * (pocket_corner_y - heel_end_y - heel_end_radius)

name: ceiling_over_recess
label: Control cavity ceiling above the cover recess

name: Bridge placed by the scale length
eq: sqrt((string_spacing / 2)^2 + (heel_end_radius + scale_length * pow(2, -frets / 12) - board_end_margin + string_hole_setback)^2) - heel_end_radius - string_hole_diameter / 2

name: Pickup routes as deep as the pickups need
Long-shaft pots reach through the top
Wall between the neck pocket and the neck route
No corner face of a radius under the bit
Route and pocket corners cut by the 1/2 in bit
Pickups spaced by the scale
eq: (neck_end_y - neck_pocket_length - neck_route_wall - route_width / 2) - (neck_end_y - neck_pocket_length + scale_length * (1 - pow(2, -frets / 12)) + board_end_margin - scale_length + bridge_pickup_offset) - route_width

name: Back roundover tangent to the back
Jack flange seats on the straight side
expr: min(jack_low_gap - back_roundover, rim_height - top_roundover - jack_low_gap - jack_hole)

title: Electric guitar body
description: An original double-cutaway solid body in red alder with a carved top, a bolt-on neck pocket, two humbucker routes and a rear control cavity, its bridge placed by the scale length; finished in candy-apple red.
author: 3DCraft examples
